note: Approximate Verde River overview. Channel position and obstacles vary; this is not a navigation line.

review.reviewer: Float ETA complete directed-network and overlapping imagery review
review.note: All 14 overlapping course panels and endpoint images reviewed. Original USGS source vertices retained. No downstream forks in the full named-and-unnamed source network. Wooded banks and riffles generalized; no precise navigation, mileage adoption or timing enabled. Agency paddle-guide segments 8–9 also reviewed: minor diversion structures, rock bars, old bank-stabilization metal, tree hazards and Class II riffles are named in section notices. No current runnable passage, portage or chute is inferred from the historical guide.

acceptedIssues.endpoint-offset-over-100m: White Bridge is an agency public facility/parking-area coordinate, about 167 m from the river. The source course begins on the river without an invented connector; both positions remain unchanged.

overviewReview.routeReview: Approximate river-course overview only; the river moves within its wooded corridor. Access-area markers are separate from the course, and no shore connection or walking route is mapped.
overviewReview.note: The line follows the river’s bends approximately. It may differ from the wetted channel around banks, vegetation and gravel bars. It does not identify a clear chute or landing.
